name: Argentina
description: Argentina from the Andes and the Pampas to independence, immigrants, Perón and Evita, dictatorship and democracy, tango and football.

checkpoints.name: Before the Spanish
checkpoints.note: Hunters painted hands in Patagonian caves, and the Inca empire reached into the north-west.

checkpoints.name: Colony and independence
checkpoints.note: Buenos Aires was founded and became the capital of a viceroyalty. Revolution in 1810 and the declaration of 1816 won independence, and San Martín carried the fight over the Andes.

checkpoints.name: Immigrants and Perón
checkpoints.note: Millions of Europeans came to farm the Pampas, and Argentina grew rich. Tango rose in Buenos Aires, and Perón and Evita rallied the workers.

checkpoints.name: Dictatorship and democracy
checkpoints.note: The junta made thousands disappear and lost the Falklands War. Democracy returned in 1983, Maradona and Messi won World Cups, and crises came and went.
